/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/visualization-data.ts')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace(\"import type {VisualizationMode, VisualizationModeData} from './visualization-types';\", \"\"\"import type {
    VisualizationDataset,
    VisualizationMode,
    VisualizationModeData,
} from './visualization-types';\"\"\")
p.write_text(s)
p = Path('src/VisualizationWidget.tsx')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace(\"\"\"<MonitoringChart
                        type=\"yagr\"
                        data={data.data}
                        libraryConfig={data.libraryConfig}
                    />\"\"\", \"\"\"<MonitoringChart type=\"yagr\" data={data.data} />\"\"\")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npm run build"

npm run build"
